import json
from pathlib import Path
from statistics import mean, variance
values = json.loads(Path("observations.json").read_text())["values"]
result = {"count": len(values), "mean": mean(values), "sampleVariance": variance(values)}
Path("result.json").write_text(json.dumps(result, sort_keys=True, allow_nan=False))
